scope: Profile-local owned-child destinations, explicit worktree project registration, actual task board deep links, initiating selection/profile fences. No runtime execution graph.

GET /api/conversations/{session_id}/suba.ownership: Existing dashboard auth and full parent compression-family membership; 404 for missing/unowned child.
GET /api/conversations/{session_id}/suba.task: supported/reason and actual id, run_id, title, board_slug only for a unique existing task in the active profile kanban.db whose task_runs.metadata_json.execution.session_id matches the parent compression family.
GET /api/conversations/{session_id}/suba.worktree: supported/reason and verified project_slug, path, branch. Snapshot refs must match active-profile worktree metadata, expected checkout root, branch, registered Git worktree, common repository storage and recorded base commit.
GET /api/conversations/{session_id}/suba.read_only: No board creation/schema repair. Ignore assigned worker board-home overrides; refuse foreign board symlinks. Missing/legacy/corrupt/ambiguous references are unavailable.

POST /api/conversations/{session_id}/sub.request: Explicit user action; no caller path or options accepted. Revalidates ownership, metadata and real checkout.
POST /api/conversations/{session_id}/sub.receipt: Atomic local-folder workspace symlink is idempotent after lost acknowledgement. Reuse only an existing matching symlink; reject directory, foreign or broken-link collision.
POST /api/conversations/{session_id}/sub.preservation: No copy, setup, git init, commit, merge, deletion, cleanup, worker interruption, provider call or model send.

frontend.navigation: GET only on detail verification; clicks freshly verify task or POST worktree. Publish and require project slug in refreshed project list before navigating. Fence awaited responses by mounted generation, selected parent and backend/profile scope.
frontend.task_route: Existing KanbanPage lazily registered as task deep-link destination only; opens actual task board_slug, no new primary navigation section.
frontend.reload_fix: Consume live global targets in mounted owners so a later reload cannot resurrect an old project target.
